wartimeMustang.title: Wright Field TSCEP5E-1908, B.4 Normal-rated power level flight

conditions.installation: Trial wing racks fitted, no external load

wartimeMustang.role: Same-report level-speed check outside the sea-level WEP polar fit. BHP from the wartime chart is a model input.

spitfire.title: A&AEE BS.543 Table II, Combat climb
spitfire.qualification: Rates and TAS use the existing Table II transcription. A&AEE reduced the data to standard atmosphere via Res/170. The rate reduction's treatment of TAS energy is unresolved.

assumptions: Use reported MSL as pressure altitude and account for 50°F with the corresponding density and TAS. The ISA solver runs at equivalent density altitude, with power held at the pressure-altitude input.
Use the wartime V-1650-7 Normal chart's 1,140 BHP at 46 inHg and 2,700 RPM as a V-1650-9 METO proxy. The restored specimen's actual manifold pressure, RPM and shaft power are unknown.
Carry the wartime wing-rack drag polar and shared propeller model. The restored run's rack fit, cooling opening and installed propeller efficiency are unknown.

Assume 8,900 lb throughout the nominal replay. The 8,700–8,900 lb scenarios explore fuel burned after takeoff. Test constant CAS–IAS offsets to show sensitivity. Specimen calibration remains unavailable.
Ranges are illustrative scenarios, with no fit or statistical confidence attached.
